description: PyPSA-Earth Database: Energy System Modelling for Net-Zero 2050 Scenarios is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors PyPSA Earth, Bryan Ramirez (Open Energy Transition). This database contains the outputs of the PyPSA-Earth energy system modeling tool, which was used to simulate net-zero emission scenarios by 2050. The dataset includes inputs needed to build a model extracted by an automated data pre-processing workflow, models of the power infrastructure in high spatial resolution, and results of optimisation runs. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
